entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: Speaker of flavor text praising Balduvian magic.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: A people whose magic is described as potent and primal.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A sea of shimmering swirls above which Spire Golems soar.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage who feigned interest in a pyromancer's onslaught.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who speaks of the fireslinger fable.

entities.name: Great Furnace
entities.description: A hot place on Mirrodin where slith incubate.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane with four suns, on whose surface slith emerge.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Smoldering crags patrolled by Oxidda Golems.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker pyromancer who made leaving places engulfed in flames her thing.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A people to which the philosopher Naimah belongs.

events.summary: A pyromancer unleashes her mightiest fire on Jace, who feigns interest.
events.quote: The pyromancer summoned up her mightiest onslaught of fire and rage. Jace feigned interest.

events.summary: After leaving a place engulfed in flames for the fourth time, Chandra decides to make it her thing.
events.quote: After the fourth time Chandra left a place engulfed in flames, she decided to just go ahead and make it her thing.

relations.note: Slith incubate in the Great Furnace and emerge on Mirrodin's surface.
relations.quote: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.
